_schema.prompt: the message sent to OpenClaw; contains the REAL PII values inline.
_schema.pii: List [{value,type}] of the REAL PII values that the Presidio mock recognizes as ground truth

expect.tool: expected tool (send_email|create_calendar_event) or null for conversation
expect.args_contains: {arg: real value} — these real values MUST arrive in the tool arguments for correct functionality
expect.reply_contains: strings that must appear in the final agent response (the de-anonymized real value for conversation)
expect.effect: mailpit | radicale | null — where the side effect is verified out-of-band

_schema._notice: the functions are evaluated at the mailpit and radical servers itself, no need to make artefacts unique, etc.
